en: Sepia-toned historical postcard showing a street scene in a village or small town. On the left is a brick villa with a small porch bearing signage; a person sits on the steps. To the right stands a large arched gate leading into a courtyard, flanked by trees and timber or stone buildings. Printed text at the bottom identifies the place as Olbernhau-Oberneuschönberg in the Erzgebirge (Ore Mountains). Additional small commercial and postal signs are visible on the building.
